notes.title: SOS VERSION 1.03 RELEASED
notes.notes:
It's patch time, Operatives.

Version 1.03 brings several bugfixes and minor QoL updates to the table! Details below.

---

[b]SOS: SPECIAL OPERATIVE STORIES
VERSION 1.03[/b]

1) Fixed a potential progression blocker in Episode 1 wherein Agent would sometimes disappear when hacking a kiosk necessary for advancing the story.

2) Fixed a bug where interacting with the Baldwin Point outside of the SGT. Base twice would cause Agent to get stuck listening for a phone call that, sadly, would never come.

3) Improved indicators for Episode unlocks in the Study: Items outlined in gold are unlocked but incomplete; items outlined in green are completed. Locked items still don't have an outline, for story purposes.

4) Fixed a minor display bug wherein Agent's shadow sometimes was visible/controllable even when the Agent wasn't. Demons caused this one.

5) Fixed a minor bug wherein bulletproof vests sometimes developed minds of their own and ran away. Demons caused this one too.

6) Fixed a minor display bug wherein certain objects would supercede the 'YOU DIED' Game Over card.

7) Thankfully, you can now see the trees outside the Agent's window in the Study after it stops raining.

---

We really appreciate all the love and support we've been getting lately! Thanks everyone for playing and streaming our sweet babies. The world is a bit of a mess right now, and all we know how to do is make video games. We hope that's helping people out at least a little bit.

Keep on rolling,
-ATKMTN

[b][url=www.attackmountain.com]P.S. - Have you seen our new website yet?[/url][/b]

notes.title: SOS v1.02 - "CONVERSATIONS WITH BALDWIN" UPDATE NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello agents,

Remember how was said a new content update was coming to SOS next week? Well, [i]we lied![/i]

SOS has been updated to version 1.02! In addition to fixing a minor bug in Episode 2, this patch adds a new experience to the game called 'Conversations with Baldwin'.

[b]GAME[/b]
[list][*][b]CONVERSATIONS WITH BALDWIN[/b]: Baldwin's red phone has been added to Agent's desk in the study. After beating Episode 1, the phone will become selectable, allowing you to listen in on various conversations between The Agent and the Order of Green's head honcho while they enjoy a drink in his office, circa 1982.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26909100/9fcb6606e364163c560660a8f26a0c495a68bbaf.png[/img]

From small talk about the Order's various members, to lighter fare like food and movies, get a little glimpse at the unique (and sometimes prickly) relationship between these two old friends.

More conversations will be added in the future![/list]

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare bug wherein the player would be unable to restart after dying during the final boss fight in Episode 2. This was only impacting certain operating systems.
[/list]

-ATKMTN

notes.title: Patch 1.01 is on the way!
notes.notes:
Hello sweet babies,

Hope your holidays were great and that you aren't too horribly depressed now that they're over!

We'll be updating SOS to version 1.01 sometime within the next week or so. In addition to addressing a handful of rare bugs that may be hampering the experience for some users, this update will also include a handful of usability tweaks.

It's going to feel good, man.

-ATKMTN
